prompt_text: write a song for Indian PM who wants to impress the Indian Youth and in the lyrics he explains who he will tackles their issues and bring more joy and happiness to their lives
response_text:
**Title: “Umeed Ki Dhoop” (Sunrise of Hope)**  

*Style – a vibrant mix of pop‑rock with a catchy rap bridge, sung in Hindi‑English, perfect for campus stages, TikTok reels and road‑trip playlists.*

---

### **[Intro – Soft acoustic strum]**  
*(Whispered)*  
“Yeh nayi subah, nayi raah…  
Sabke sapne, sabka raag…”  

---

### **[Verse 1]**  
*Tempo picks up, bright guitars*  

> **(Hindi)**  
> “Shehar ki galiyon mein, sapne hain chhote‑chhote,  
> Par dil ki dhadkan badi, har ek aarzoo ko roke.  
> Roz ki pareshani, traffic, padhai ka pressure,  
> Main sunta hoon tumhara, har ek choti‑badi treasure.”  

> **(English)**  
> “From Delhi’s rush to the hills of Coorg,  
> Your hopes are louder than any storm.  
> Jobs, tech, climate, love, and study stress—  
> I’m here to listen, to turn the mess into success.”  

---

### **[Pre‑Chorus]**  
*Clap‑track builds, synths rise*  

> “Aao milke likhen, ek naya chapter,  
> Jahan har youth ka ho bright future.  
> Na sirf promises, balki action ka fire,  
> Saath chalenge hum, aage badhenge higher!”  

---

### **[Chorus – Anthemic, sing‑along]**  

> **(Hindi‑English mix)**  
> “Umeed ki dhoop, hum sabke sang,  
> Har dil mein rang, har sapna rang.  
> Together we’ll rise, together we’ll shine,  
> Youth ki awaaz, desh ki line!”  

> *(Repeat with crowd chanting “Umeed! Umeed!”)*  

---

### **[Verse 2]**  
*Add a light tabla beat, modern bass*  

> **(Hindi)**  
> “Skilling ke centres, start‑up ki seed,  
> Digital classrooms, har school mein speed.  
> Green highways, clean air, solar ki roshni,  
> Har gaon, har shehar, banega naya roshni.”  

> **(English)**  
> “Internships, scholarships, a tech‑first plan,  
> Affordable health, a stronger, greener land.  
> From startups to farms, we’ll bridge the gap,  
> Your future’s in your hands – let’s map the map!”  

---

### **[Rap Bridge – Youth‑focused, fast‑paced]**  

> “Yo, listen up, Gen‑Z, Gen‑Alpha,  
> We’re coding, gaming, making art, ya!  
> Jobs ain’t just 9‑to‑5, we’re building AI,  
> Renewable power, drones in the sky.  
>  
> Education on the go, e‑learning on the phone,  
> Scholarships for the bold, no one’s left alone.  
> Mental health, safe spaces, we’re breaking the stigma,  
> Together we’ll rise, we’re the new India‑prisma!”  

*(Beat drops, crowd claps)*  

---

### **[Bridge – Soft, hopeful]**  

> **(Hindi)**  
> “Har ek musibat ka hoga solution,  
> Tumhara confidence, mera resolution.  
> Jo bhi ho challenge, hum milke karenge fight,  
> Saath‑saath, har din, har raat, har light.”  

> **(English)**  
> “No problem too big, no dream too small,  
> With your voice, we’ll answer every call.  
> Together we’ll write the story of tomorrow,  
> Joy, peace, progress – no more sorrow.”  

---

### **[Final Chorus – Full band, fireworks]**  

> “Umeed ki dhoop, hum sabke sang,  
> Har dil mein rang, har sapna rang.  
> Together we’ll rise, together we’ll shine,  
> Youth ki awaaz, desh ki line!  

> **(All together, louder)**  
> “Umeed! Umeed! Umeed! – Let’s light the sky!”  

---

### **[Outro – Fading acoustic, humming]**  

> “Nayi subah, nayi raah…  
> Sabke sapne, sabka raag…  
> With you, with us, we’ll walk the path,  
> India’s youth – the heart, the math.”  

---  

**Performance notes:**  

- **Instrumentation:** Acoustic guitar → electric lead → tabla & dholak → synth pads → rap‑beat drums.  
- **Visuals for a live show:** Youth‑driven murals, drone light‑shows spelling “UmeED,” flash‑mob dance crews in college campuses, QR‑codes projecting government apps for skill‑training.  
- **Message focus:** concrete actions (skill‑centres, digital classrooms, green infrastructure, mental‑health support) wrapped in an uplifting, inclusive vibe that tells every young Indian: *Your voice matters, your future is bright, and we’re walking together.*
